description: This file contains code that embeds static web UI files into a Go binary. It provides handlers to serve these embedded files over HTTP using Gin, functions to check if the UI is embedded, retrieve specific files, and list all embedded files.

methods.name: EmbeddedUIHandler
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler using Gin that serves the embedded UI files under the '/ui' path.

methods.name: EmbeddedSPAHandler
methods.description: Serves the 'index.html' file for single-page application routing from the embedded files.

methods.name: IsUIEmbedded
methods.description: Checks if the embedded UI files are present by attempting to read 'index.html'.

methods.name: GetEmbeddedFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific embedded UI file given its relative path.

methods.name: ListEmbeddedFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of all embedded UI file paths.
